issue.title: Upgrading the Gui to Qml tracking issue
issue.body:
[GUI-QML](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui-qml) is a new graphical interface for Bitcoin Core, built with Qt Quick and QML. The goal is to improve usability and make GUI code easier to maintain and test, while reusing Core's node and wallet interfaces.

This issue tracks the PRs landing in the [staging branch](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui-qml/tree/staging). The `staging` branch will be based on `bitcoin/bitcoin`. It will replace `bitcoin-qt` and `bitcoin-gui` with our qml implementation. The existing Qt Widgets GUI remains available as `bitcoin-qt-legacy` during this transition. At the end of the process `src/qt` can be removed.

Detailed issues and follow-up work are tracked on the [project board](https://github.com/orgs/bitcoin-core/projects/1).

## Staging branch chunks

The PRs build on one another and are listed in merge order. Items will be checked when it is first merged into `staging`. `fixup!` commits will be used to apply fixes to earlier chunks during regular rebases.

- [x] 1. Foundation — build support, startup/shutdown and test infrastructure. [bitcoin-core/gui-qml#871](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui-qml/pull/871)
- [x] 2. Onboarding and settings — node setup, application shell, global menu and translations. [bitcoin-core/gui-qml#887](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui-qml/pull/887) — open for review.
- [x] 3. Block clock — clock display, sync/header progress and ETA, connectivity indicators, network pause/resume and warnings shown with the clock. [bitcoin-core/gui-qml#887](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui-qml/pull/887) — initially landed together with chunk 2; open for review.
- [ ] 4. Node tools and diagnostics — RPC console, debug log, node information, peers/bans, traffic and mempool. [bitcoin-core/gui-qml#890](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui-qml/pull/890) — draft.
- [ ] 5. Wallet management — create, load and close wallets; overview, security, backup/restore and migration. PR pending.
- [ ] 6. Wallet activity — transaction history and details, filters, export, labels, privacy and recovery actions. PR pending.
- [ ] 7. Wallet receiving — addresses and contacts, payment requests, QR codes and message signing/verification. PR pending.
- [ ] 8. Wallet sending — recipients, separate fee selection model, coin control, transaction review and sending. PR pending.
- [ ] 9. PSBT operations — import/export, review, local signing and submission. PR pending.
- [ ] 10. Fee replacement — transaction fee increases, replacement review and PSBT fee-bump support. PR pending.
- [ ] 11. Watch-only wallets — wallet creation and descriptor setup, unsigned transactions and watch-only export. PR pending.
- [ ] 12. External signers — signer setup, wallet creation, explicit signing approval, incomplete-signature recovery and receive-address verification. PR pending.
- [ ] 13. Payment-request import — BIP21 links, clipboard and files, with review before applying to Send. PR pending.

Each chunk can contain multiple feature epics on the project board. Each epic identifies its owning chunk in its title and description.

Each chunk includes focused models and tests. Regression coverage belongs in unit, QML and integration tests, with a small Python test-bridge end-to-end suite for core user flows.

This issue is complete when the listed chunks have landed in the `staging` branch, the `staging` branch PR into master is reviewed and merged, and work on gui qml has migrated.
